notes: Owner OD-11. Accepted costs (critique M-06, decision challenge: prescribed by the Target API, OD-6 and OD-11): an unconditional PUT to an unknown id creates a permanent phantom SKU (a typo such as ABC-l for ABC-1 lists as {"skuId":"ABC-l","quantity":0}, and a purchase of it answers 400 "Insufficient inventory", not 404) and no API deletes it (G5); the Create page always sends If-None-Match: * so the front end never does this by accident. /v2 lock-in: the leniencies (a bad limit is ignored, no precondition is required to create) cannot be tightened later without /v3. 428 (RFC 6585 §3) was rejected: the approved contract creates unconditionally.
